issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

useArtifactHub.description:
If true, the C3 library manager will use the {@link ArtifactHub} to fetch libraries when installing environments instead of fetching
them directly from the repository declared in its config. If false, the C3 Npm library manager will use the npm registry in the
{@link NpmLibraryManager.Config} to fetch packages and the C3 Conda library manager will use the artifacthub to fetch libraries directly
from the Conda and PyPI repositories declared in the {@link CondaLibraryManager.Config}.

title: Type for specifying different configurations used by {@link NpmLibraryManager}.
name: NpmLibraryManager.Config
